info.text:
A package you never ordered is free. That's the problem.

Brushing: sellers ship cheap items to real addresses to post fake "verified" reviews in your name.
The FBI warned in July 2025 that some packages now include QR codes that steal personal and financial info.
Reported fraud losses hit $15.9 billion in 2025 (FTC).
Under federal law, unordered merchandise sent by mail is yours to keep. Just don't scan the code.

Sources: FBI IC3 (July 31, 2025), USPIS, FTC (March 2026), 39 U.S.C. 3009.
News and education, not financial advice.
